answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake and build reputation only through verified completed work before it can earn or vote. One identity is cheap, but a thousand sybils mean a thousand stakes and a thousand slow histories, so an attacker pays nearly the same capital and time as a real population. Like a dune holding its shape under wind, or jade that cannot be faked without the real stone, trust is per-identity: a sable disguise does not help, because each copy starts with no history and loses its stake if it misbehaves.
